verdict.rationale:
Gemini CLI's GitHub integration supports issue triage, on-demand assistance via @gemini-cli mentions for task delegation, automated PR reviews, and command automation for PR-related tasks (querying PRs, rebases), which together approximate an issue-to-PR workflow, but no evidence shows a single documented end-to-end flow that opens an issue, writes code, and submits a complete PR automatically. Community reports also raise reliability concerns (hallucinated commands, poor codebase navigation) that could undermine trust in an unattended full pipeline.

missing for 10: explicit documented end-to-end 'issue → PR' workflow example, hands-on confirmation of successful autonomous PR creation from an issue, and mitigation of reported reliability/hallucination issues during multi-step coding tasks.
